I hate you to death, but I still can't let go of you.

You are my salvation, and I am your breath, I love you, my one and only fantasy.

description.en:
Elaine lived an unassuming life as a maid. She thought she finally got her big break when the princess recognized her abilities and promoted her. But then Elaine fell in love with someone she shouldn't have liked. She tried to close her heart and hide her love away.

"Don't avoid my eyes."

Why would he care about me?

Contrary to his harsh words, he was surprisingly kind, which only made it more difficult. The life of a palace maid who has to endure the temptation of the handsome prince who smelled like forget-me-nots. Will she be able to live like this?

---
After giving up her dream to become a priestess, Elaine resignedly applies to work as a maid in the imperial palace and earn money for her family. While working, she runs into a mysterious man who treats her with unusual kindness. Moved by his gestures, Elaine begins to fall for him... until she finds out he's none other than the war hero, Prince Theo Veronica! But just when she tries to distance herself from the prince, he offers her a unique deal that will change her life forever.

description.en:
A ninth-grade civil servant, Seo Jihoon, only ever wished for a long, quiet, and peaceful life. 

But after being fatally stabbed by a violent petitioner, the place where he opened his eyes again was none other than a martial world where martial arts truly existed. Even there, he only wanted to live quietly… Until he encountered the one man he should never have crossed paths with. 

“Choose. Die here, or become my disciple.” 

An old man who pressed a blade to his throat without warning. His true identity, the cult leader of the Heavenly Demon Sect. Thinking survival comes first before anything else, Seo Jihoon had no choice but to become part of the Heavenly Demon. Once a capable public servant, he grew into an unrivaled talent within the sect, armed with powerful martial arts and sharp intellect.

But why does the work keep piling up? Why does he keep getting promoted?! His original goal was simply a peaceful life, yet somehow, his second life is racing down the path of the Heavenly Demon. Will he ever be able to find the life he truly desires in this world?

(Source: MangaUpdates)

description.en: In the Kingdom of Strandeon, one man from each noble family is required to serve in the Order of the Royal Vine, and Aristité is chosen to fulfill this duty for House Theseus. One day, while the order is carrying out a mission, a witch places a curse on Aristité, saying that he’ll lose something important. Everyone in the order thinks that this curse is what transforms Aristité into a woman, but little do they know that Aristité, whose real name is Ariel, was a woman from the start. All the curse did was take away her special medicine that changes her voice. With the help of her friends and cousin, Ariel struggles to protect her secret, but someone in the order seems determined to expose her and land her in trouble...

altTitles.ja: リアルワールド：最強になったオタク

description.en: Gang-u Choi is an ordinary high school student who likes video games. One day, he hears that his favorite game store is going out of business. When he visits the shop one last time, the store owner hands him a QR code for a mobile game. Gang-u starts up the game out of curiosity, but something feels off…. His mission is to drink 3 glasses of water?! When he decides to ignore the mission, he suddenly receives a penalty in real life! As the missions get more dangerous, will Gang-u be able to protect his reality?

Two princesses, one throne.
Life is hard for a court jester. Not only do I serve as an emotional punching bag for the royals and aristocrats, forced to indulge their every whim, but now I'm also caught between two princesses. Is this a comedy? Or will this tale end in tragedy?

description.en:
"I ended up taming the Monster Prince in the imperial palace where I was sent off like disposable property."

Irena, a bastard child from a prestigious noble family, was married off to the Frist Prince, who carried the stigma of being a monster prince due to a curse. This marriage was no different from being disposed of. 

She thought she was destined to die on her wedding night, just like previous princess candidates, but unexpectedly, she managed to calm the monster prince with an unforeseen ability and began to live with him...
description.id: Dia menikah dengan seorang pangeran yang dijuluki monster. Konon keempat wanita yang pernah bertunangan dengannya semuanya telah berubah menjadi mayat berlumuran darah. Jadi, singkatnya, aku adalah korban hidup yang dipersembahkan kepada monster ini. Malam pertama persiapan menghadapi kematian. “Grrr…” Suara binatang bergema di tenggorokannya. Namun… Sebuah keajaiban terjadi. “Baiklah, diam saja.” "Hah." Dia mendongak diam-diam dan menaruh kepalanya di pangkuanku. Bahkan sampai menjulurkan dagunya lebih jauh dengan memutarnya dari sisi ke sisi. Kau ingin aku menepukmu? * “Ren, kumohon jangan pergi.” “Aku tidak bisa hidup tanpamu.” Dia masih memiliki pandangan sedih di matanya dan menarik lengan bajuku. Sudut hatiku yang terluka bergaung keras. Tampaknya aku telah menjinakkan monster ini dengan sangat baik.
description.it: Irena, un’orfana illegittima appartenente a una famiglia nobiliare, viene data in sposa al Primo Principe dell’impero, etichettato come il “Principe Demone” a causa di una maledizione. Come le candidate al titolo prima di lei, teme di essere vittima di un qualche crudele destino la notte di nozze. Tuttavia, grazie a un’abilità misteriosa, riesce a calmare il principe e conquistarne la fiducia, iniziando così a restare al suo fianco rompendo la reputazione letale che lo circonda…
description.ko:
[처분되듯 시집 간 황궁에서 괴물 황자를 길들여 버렸다.] 

저주로 인해 괴물 황자라는 오명을 가진 1황자에게 시집 가게 된 이레네아. 
명망 높은 귀족가의 사생아였기에 처분 당한 것이나 다름없는 결혼이었다. 
이전 황자비 후보들처럼 첫날밤에 죽을 운명인 줄 알았지만, 
뜻밖의 능력으로 괴물 황자를 진정시키고, 괴물 황자와 함께 하게 되는데…
description.pl: Zostałam wydana za mąż za księcia, którego nazywano potworem. Mówiło się, że już cztery kobiety, z którymi prowadzono rozmowy o jego małżeństwie, zostały znalezione martwe, całe we krwi. Innymi słowy, stałam się żywą ofiarą złożoną temu potworowi. W noc poślubną, przygotowana na śmierć, usłyszałam pomruk przypominający dźwięk wydawany przez dzikie zwierzę. Dźwięk ten rozchodził się z jego gardła. I wtedy wydarzył się cud. Położył głowę na moich kolanach, jakby szukał czułości, a jego broda poruszała się lekko, jakby domagał się głaskania. Z czasem, kiedy nadszedł moment rozstania, chwycił za moje rękawy ze wzrokiem pełnym bólu i błagania. Jego słowa i gesty świadczyły o tym, że nie potrafiłby żyć beze mnie. Poczułam ukłucie w sercu. Najwyraźniej zbyt dobrze oswoiłam tego potwora.
description.ru:
[«Меня выдали замуж, словно избавляясь от мусора, но я укротила принца-монстра в императорском дворце»]

Иринею насильно выдали за проклятого Первого принца, прозванного «монстром».
Как незаконнорождённая дочь влиятельного аристократического рода, она стала разменной монетой в политической игре. Брак был лишь способом избавиться от «позора» семьи.
Девушка готовилась разделить участь предыдущих невест, погибших в первую же брачную ночь, но неожиданно пробудившийся в ней дар позволил усмирить чудовищную сущность принца, и теперь им предстоит жить вместе...
description.pt-br: [Ela foi domesticada pelo príncipe monstro no palácio onde se casou, como se tivesse sido descartada.] Irenea foi forçada a se casar com o primeiro príncipe , que foi marcado como um príncipe monstro devido a uma maldição. Como filha ilegítima de uma prestigiosa família nobre, era um casamento praticamente fadado ao fracasso. Assim como as candidatas anteriores ao trono, ela pensava que estava destinada a morrer na noite de núpcias, mas com uma habilidade inesperada, ela acalma o príncipe monstro e acaba ficando com ele…

Eun Ga-bi went to an alternative school in remote areas of Gangwon-do, as if running away after a friend's unfair death.  
There, she accepts a secret training method… Eun Ga-bi's full-fledged revenge begins!

A beautiful and precarious love story unfolded by Hyeon-sook Lee of <The Beast Must Die>! Baek Seon-woo, who lost his job due to a riff raff at work, while waiting for an interview at a fine dining restaurant, he ends up meeting Ki Yoojung, who he had a crush on during their high school days. Just like that, a chance ecounter with a fragment of an old love excites Sunwoo, However.... somehow, Yoojung, doesn't seem to remember Sunwoo?

A woman manager in a company filled with all the yaoi clichés. All her coworkers are men, gay and very incompetent at work, most likely because they are more concerned about their "secret" dating. To add in - her superior that looks like a broom with glasses keeping himself busy all day round only by yelling at her for any little thing!  
Is she the only one who actually work in this company?!

Will you still love me once you know my secret? Angie enjoys an idyllic life of reading and embroidering on Cullinan Island. But everything changes when she's selected as the companion to Kylek, the enigmatic heir of House Blackwell. As their bond grows, extraordinary events unfold, unraveling Cullinan Island's long-kept secret.

Ho-Kyung likes the violin, but born to a normal family, he has no intention of pursuing it as a career. When he was young, it was the small violin given to him by his friend Uiju that created the small passage connecting him to music. Now as a high school student, one accident destroys the precious violin and leads Ho-Kyung to an encounter with the violin repair workshop… A journey begins with a very simple wish, the desire to have his own violin.

Дальнейшие события приводят Ан Хогёна на конкурс скрипачей. Долгий путь начнётся для него с очень простого желания — иметь свою скрипку.

description.en:
"You criminal bastard… Are you still not coming to your senses?!"

All I did was start the final difficulty of the game Abyss of the Labyrinth — and the next thing I knew, I had possessed a game character in another world. But the character I ended up in... was a criminal who became a slave?!

Every time I’m in danger, a mysterious magic called the Turn-Based Hourglass activates — stopping time for 60 seconds.

I don’t know whether it was a developer or a god who threw me into this mess, but as the Turn-Based Mage, I swear I’ll survive.

She was forced to marry. Now, her husband wants a divorce. 

Leah retreats to a secluded villa to regroup — only to be saved from danger by a mysterious leopard. 

But the wild creature is no ordinary beast; he’s Januk, a shape-shifting imperial prince, and taming him might be the start of something wild.

description.en:
Hi. Am I your first fairy?

I met a lonely child, very deep underground.
I wanted to see the kid smile.
So I was born as a flower fairy.

“I’ll promise. I will get out of here with you!”

You are a seed trapped in the ground.
In the name of the flower fairy, I will surely make you bloom.

“Yes. Let’s work together. Let’s go out together… Take each other out of here.”

To escape with the cute boy, the fairy has a lot of work to do!
We prepared hard for a long time.
And finally, an opportunity came…

We were finally out into the world.
The whole world coveted my human being in full bloom.

“You are too great for me to have.”

My first person.
My precious planet. My beloved flower.
The origin of the fairy, Shrensha, was Leoren.
I was going to let Leo go a little, very little, for Leo’s life.

“Leo is the greatest in the world. I’m just Shrensha from Leoren.”

Leo knew only me.

“Shrensha, please sign a contract with me.”

Forever.

For the sake of Kang Hanni's one and only family member, her younger brother, Kang Han, Hanni works hard everyday to earn money.

She tries to persuade Siyoung that he has to deal with those who have become ‘sinned souls’ due to their accumulated sins in order to solve his problem…… Will Siyoung be able to be free from his karma?”

In the near future, new powerful devices called relics were found. Their powers were out of this world… and so earth was destroyed.  
  
But even in this devastated state, there were three things that survived; cockroaches, scammers, and government officials!

Eun-soo Cha is the main character of the story. Eun-soo has hated her Mother ever since she was abandoned by her. Raised by her Grandma, she became a wild child that likes to fight. She has even disguised herself so well as a guy that people won't believe her even if she says she's a girl. She can fight well, and is even referred to as hot by girls. One day, however, her Grandma's already bad health worsens, and she promises not to fight anymore. When Eun-soo's grandma dies soon after, she decides to leave Dae-Jeon (where she lives) and goes to Seoul to live with her Mother, despite still hating her, because she has nowhere else to go. There, she runs into one of the best fighters, at her new school, and immediately gets on his bad side. What will happen? Will she break her promise to her grandma? Will love bloom?

For as long as she could remember, In-ha was always compared to Ye-jun.

Tired of the constant comparisons, she began pursuing art after an accidentally received art award piqued her interest. Eight years later, she meets Ye-jun… only to discover that he’s also doing art.

Fearing that she’d be compared to him again, she devises a plan to distance herself from him… but a budding romance unexpectedly forms between her and Ye-jun, the one she dislikes.
For Na-Young, school was her only haven. However, that was only before these 'things' appeared one night in school.
After being heartbroken by his crush towards senior, he is immediately confessed love by another senior. Also, they are twins?! It is a tough love between two brothers towards one student.

Seo Hyunwoo' is a member of the idol group that's about to debut. On the day of their profile shoot, an accident left a hideous scar on one side of his face, causing his dream of debuting to collapse. Fortunately, he became an idol trainer with the recommendation of his manager, but he still spent his shabby days in sorrow. One day, he got on a plane with the idol group in charge of going abroad, but an unexpected incident caused his plane to crash!!

But... "Why are you talking so loud in your sleep?" "Going back, I wanna go back..." Then he realized that he came back to when he was 19 years old; when he was preparing to join the debut team. Seo Hyunwoo, an idol who looks like a 19-year old boy but has been strengthened by his experience as a trainer before coming back. This is the story of his growth to become an idol once again.

description.en:
‘Don’t be like that. I feel bad for the maid TT’

I pitied the maid side character forgotten by the author, so I left a comment. The next day, I became that pitiful maid, Maria Mayer. Because of her zero presence, I was called a ghost. So I thought all I needed to do was work hard, but then people started becoming interested in me. The future crown prince and the grand duke!


“I can’t feel your presence at all. Who exactly are you?” the crown prince, Elias, was interested and yet cautious of Maria and decided to place her beside him.

“There’s nothing I can do if you can’t remember me. I just need to make sure you don’t forget about me from now on,” I’m sure this is our first meeting, but the grand duke approached me as though he knew me.

I-I… I’m just Regular Maid #1(nickname: Ghost)!
In a future devastated by war and desertification… is unexpectedly, a flower shop!

It's nature vs. nurture when a nerd swaps bodies with the toughest guy in school! Tuji and Usoo have swapped…their bodies! After becoming the subjects of a mad scientist's experiment with her latest invention - the quantum teleporter - their bodies are switched, leaving only their minds and spirits intact. Usoo, who was once a model student, must face the life of Tuji, a teenage menace. Never having an enemy in his life, he now has to deal with the handful of Tuji's list, but will his kinder, gentler demeanor ward off his rivals? Or will survival determine his future? Will he become the hardened fighter that matches his new exterior?

After being placed in a different class from his usual group of friends, all Do Jihwan wants is to spend an uneventful and quiet year in school. That plan goes down in shambles upon meeting one Kang Chanyoung, a popular and up-to-beat guy who has no qualms in saying what’s on his mind.

Ellen sets out on a journey to become one of them, only to learn that the hero he dreamed of is nothing more than a merciless weapon of slaughter.

Can Ellen overcome this cruel reality and become a true warrior?

Dizem que apenas os escolhidos pela Espada Espiritual podem ser chamados de “Guerreiros”.

Movido por esse ideal, Ellen parte em uma jornada para se tornar um herói — mas o que encontra é uma verdade amarga: o herói que sonhava ser não passa de uma arma feita para matar.

Diante dessa realidade brutal, conseguirá Ellen descobrir o que significa ser um verdadeiro guerreiro?

description.en: Ciella Leroix reincarnated into a story she read in her past life. Although her name and backstory resemble that of Cinderella, she is not the main character in this story. She spent most of her life being mistreated by her family, and she was almost sold off into marriage until a handsome duke struck a deal with her. After years of distrusting others, she opens up to him only to have her hope shattered once again. Ciella soon realizes that the only way for her to be happy… is to disappear.
description.pt-br: Ciella celebrou um casamento por contrato para evitar a obsessão de seu irmão adotivo. Porém, quando seu noivo, em quem ela pensava poder confiar, a trai porque ela está cega pelo amor, ela monta um novo lar para encontrar sua própria vida legítima. “Você gostaria de pegar aquela maçã?” Enquanto isso, Ciella, que deve sua vida a Otestad, um vizinho que conhece por acaso, percebe que ele é na verdade um príncipe que evitava uma ameaça. Um romance entre duas pessoas que querem escapar do seu destino e lutar contra ele. Será que Ciella conseguirá cumprir sua promessa de não permitir mais que sua vida lhe seja tirada?

description.en:
29 years old, Baek Dohee who feels hopeless and skeptical about her life, dreams of escaping from a frustrated heart, meets Jun Won in place of her friend, Nuri. Due to an unknown attraction they end up having a one night stand, but at the climax. Dohee passes days without meeting Jun Won inorder to forget that day. Dohee reunites with Jun Won, who has taken the position of team leader. However, Jun Won who shouldn't be able to remember "that day," clearly remembers Dohee and everything that happened that night. No matter how hard she tries to push him away , she's still dragged towards him who approaches her recklessly. Can the two who became emotional hedgehogs for their own reasons, will be able to break down the wall and be happy together?

---
Dohee is too busy girl-bossing her way up the corporate ladder to care about love. Her ability to randomly time loop makes her professionally successful but also renders all relationships meaningless. What's the point when she'll have to restart everything at some point?

That all changes when Joonwon, her annoying new boss, reveals that he can time loop too. Though she cringes at the mere sight of him, he's also the only person who understands her.

Will they learn how to find solace in each other, or will their professional friction mess up their one chance at love?

하룻밤 일탈의 상대가 타임 루프로 사라진 시간을 기억한다!

답답한 마음에 ‘일탈’을 꿈꾸던 도희는 친구인 누리 대신 나간 선자리에서 ‘준원'을 만난다. 알 수 없는 이끌림에 원나잇까지 하게 되지만 절정의 순간, 
어릴 때부터 무작위로 발현되어 온 ‘타임 루프’가 일어난다. 도희는 그날을 없던 일로 만들기 위해 끝끝내 준원을 만나지 않고 ‘그날’을 넘긴다. 

1년 후, 자신의 팀장 자리를 차지하게 된 준원과 재회한 도희. 
그런데 당연히 ‘그날’을 기억하지 못해야 하는 준원이 ‘그날’과 그녀를 기억한다. 

아무리 밀어내려 해도 저돌적으로 다가오는 준원에게 도희는 속절없이 말려든다.

Their date of death has been set since the day they were born… and the summer of 2018 is when Eden is destined to die. On that fateful day, , he decides to confess his feelings to his longtime crush. But Jay, who is straight and only cherishes Eden as a friend, is flustered by Eden’s confession and reacts badly. Caught up in his thoughts, Eden is met with a fatal accident—and thus his time travel begins. He finds himself on the last day of the high school summer camp training where he first met Jay. description.en: Oyoung Ji is a survivor! Growing up as an orphan, life wasn’t easy for her. To make matters worse, she narrowly escaped a brutal attack at her orphanage. The only reason Oyoung’s life was spared was that she was saved by a mysterious man. Years later, she is barely scraping a living as a hospital custodian. So when she is offered a job as a live-in assistant for Logan Lee, one of the most prestigious (and handsome!) surgeons at the hospital, she gladly accepts! Little does she know… her new boss is her savior from the orphanage!
description.pl: Oyoung Ji dorastając jako sierota, na własnej skórze odczuła, że życie nie jest usłane różami. Podczas ataku na placówkę, cudem unika śmierci wybawiona przez nieznajomego mężczyznę. Wiele lat później pracując na dwa etaty ledwo zarabia na życie jako opiekun medyczny oraz sprzątając w bursie, w zamian za nocleg. Kiedy więc miejsce, jej dotychczasowego zamieszkania plajtuje, jak z nieba spada na nią propozycja stałej pracy jako gosposia Logana Li, najlepszego z chirurgów w szpitalu, chętnie ją przyjmuje. Nie wiedząc... że jej nowy szef jest jej wybawcą z sierocińca.

description.en:
A historical Eastern romance where Beom-yoon, a younger man walking a blood-stained royal road, ascends to the untouchable position of emperor, seeking to possess Cheong-hee, an older woman. Based on the original work by Chomchom.

Beom-yoon, a prince of Goyeon with the destiny of a Yaksha, enters an arranged marriage with Cheong-hee, who is fated to be an exorcist and used as a living amulet.

"Do you pity me, Your Highness?"

"You'd better receive my respect while I treat you with honor..."

Haejin and Kihyuk met at the same Taekwondo dojang when they were young. At one time, the two had been quite close, but as they went their respective paths in life, they became more distant, no better than strangers now.

In truth, from the days they went to taekwondo together, and even now, Haejin had always looked up to Kihyuk. And finally at the start of the 1st year of high school, the two reunite, now attending the same school, in the same class. However, his anticipation is hopelessly shattered when Kihyuk appears, looking by all means like a total trainwreck.

Still Haejin's feelings for Kihyuk refuses to fade, rather sparking his obsessive and control-freak side. Haejin vows to restore the object of his admiration to his former glory. So begins the inexplicable crackdown - Haejin's great Kihyuk makeover project.

Jia is an average girl who, along with the majority of her classmates, has fallen head over heels for Yoona, a girl so pretty she's practically the school's idol. They're on two totally different levels, but Jia can ignore her feelings no longer! But who is Yoona, really? Stay tuned to see what romance unfolds between these two!
description.pt: Jia é uma garota comum que, junto com a maioria de seus colegas de classe, se apaixonou por Yoona, uma garota tão bonita que é praticamente o ídolo da escola. Elas estão em dois níveis totalmente diferentes, mas Jia não pode mais ignorar seus sentimentos! Mas quem é Yoona, realmente? Fique ligado para ver o desenrola do romance entre esses dois!

description.en: The Subcontractors were nothing more than Robots I was grateful for. It was only natural to squeeze everything out of them. But after being betrayed by the group I worked for, I opened my eyes in a new body and finally saw the tears of those "Robots." Having gained a second life on the brink of death, can my soul be saved?

The Great Merchant Kim Manduk portrays the story of a poor young girl who, despite the misfortunes she had to face in life, made it to become the best merchant in Joseon. We will see her undergoing many troubles and hardships, as well as finding true love when she least expects it.
Seung Hyun and Gimmi used to go out with each other, but they eventually broke up. A couple years later, they happened to run into each other. Do their romantic feelings still remain?
